g.text: The shifted roof on the current house
Actual +197.52 mm height comparison • four roof pitches • court opening retained • no change to the selected house.
South-west view. The pitch stays at 25° and the open court stays open.
Front elevation • dashed: selected physical eave
Roof height belongs to a proposal
The roof steel joins below the ridge cover.
A 220 × 120 collector and paired horizontal ties carry the pitched frames.
The actual roof ridge purlin participates in wind delivery; the roof deck is not a rigid plate.
Arch movement, full-frame renewal and fire / weather closure.
